description: Cobalt Strike (Empire / Nishang / Invoke-CradleCrafter lineage) beacon staging, download cradles, base64-EncodedCommand wrappers, CMD→PowerShell handoff patterns, and layered obfuscation variants. Curated deterministic Phase R1 pack (technique-first taxonomy).

techniques.description: Classic Empire/Nishang lineage: `IEX ((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString($url))` payload delivery.
Invoke-CradleCrafter Cradle 5 / TokenLevel 4 output: URL or cmdlet name split into a PS array and rejoined with `-join ''` at call time.
Nishang / Invoke-Encode reconstruction of URL or cmdlet names via `[String]::Join('', @('h','t','t','p'...))`.
Empire Set-EncodedString: fixed alphabet indexed with `[a..b]` ranges + `[a,b,c]` lists to reconstruct cmdlets and URLs.
Cobalt Strike Malleable-C2 sleep-with-jitter: `Start-Sleep -Seconds (30+30)` to hinder static timing analysis.
Public Cobalt Strike beacon staging pattern: `$sc = [Convert]::FromBase64String('...'); IEX $sc`.
`curl` used as a PowerShell alias for Invoke-WebRequest, chained to `iex`.
URL broken into 2-4 single-quoted concat fragments and reassembled via variable propagation before download.
Base64-encoded UTF-16LE script delivered via `-EncodedCommand` / `-Enc` / `-enc` (with optional -NoP -NonI -W Hidden flags).
cmd.exe launches powershell.exe with `^`-escaped characters and/or `-EncodedCommand` — Emotet/QakBot signature staging pattern.
`powershell.exe` command name and switches reconstructed at runtime from `$env:ComSpec[..]`, `$env:PATH[..]` and `[string]::Join()`.
Payload wrapped in three sequential encodings: raw hex over base64 over UTF-16LE — the engine must peel each layer in one convergence run.
Backtick escape characters inserted mid-identifier (`i`w`r`, `i`e`x`) to break signature matching.
